data.title: Hey, That's My Place
data.solution:
from math import ceil
h = int(input())
w = int(input())
n = int(input())
turns = [*map(int,input().split())]
grid = []
for _ in ' '*h:
    grid += [input()]

cr = (h-1)//2
cc = (w-1)//2

hori = grid[cr]
vert = []
for i in range(h):
    vert += [grid[i][cc]]

# row transformation model
overlap_base = hori
if len(vert) > len(hori):
    overlap_base = overlap_base.center(len(vert), ' ')
cc = (len(overlap_base)-1)//2 # Patch

# Rotate 90 Clockwise - +1
overlap = ''
for i in range(h-1,-1,-1):
    vert_seat = vert[i]
    alpha = i-cr
    hori_seat = overlap_base[cc-alpha]
    if vert_seat == hori_seat:
        overlap += vert_seat
    elif vert_seat == ' ' or hori_seat == ' ':
        overlap += (vert_seat+hori_seat).strip()
    elif vert_seat != hori_seat:
        overlap += ' '
overlap = overlap_base[:cc+1-ceil(len(overlap)/2)] + overlap + overlap_base[cc+ceil(len(overlap)/2):]

# Rotate 90 Anticlockwise - -1
overlap_rev = ''
for i in range(h):
    vert_seat = vert[i]
    alpha = i-cr
    hori_seat = overlap_base[cc+alpha]
    if vert_seat == hori_seat:
        overlap_rev += vert_seat
    elif vert_seat == ' ' or hori_seat == ' ':
        overlap_rev += (vert_seat+hori_seat).strip()
    elif vert_seat != hori_seat:
        overlap_rev += ' '
overlap_rev = overlap_base[:cc+1-ceil(len(overlap_rev)/2)] + overlap_rev + overlap_base[cc+ceil(len(overlap_rev)/2):]    

# States
'''
hor - horizontal row
vert - vertical coloumn
overlap_base - formatted horizontal row with space to even out
overlap - Overlap Condition +1
overlap_rev - Overlap Condition -1
'''
states = [hori, overlap, hori, overlap_rev]

global_turn = 0
for turn in turns:
    global_turn = (global_turn + turn)%4
    print(states[global_turn])
data.statement:
At your favorite game, a fun challenge breaks out in the crowd! To boost harmony between rival fans, the stadium hosts a playful seat mix-up. The stands are represented as a <<2D grid>> of seats — <<each cell has one of three types>>:

Fan {{A}}

Fan {{B}}

{{Space}} (an empty seat)

A special fan sits at a chosen center seat. From that center, imagine a plus (+) shape — the center itself, and all seats directly above, below, left, and right until the borders of the grid.

<<The Twist>>

For each given turn, the horizontal seats stay <<fixed>> while the vertical seats rotate around the center.
Positive [[turns]]: rotate the vertical line clockwise by 90° per turn.
Negative [[turns]]: rotate counterclockwise by 90° per turn.
At the end of each [[turns]], output <<only the horizontal line>> after applying the rotation.

When vertical and horizontal seats overlap:
If both are the same fan type, that fan remains <<visible>>.
If they are rival fans, the cell becomes <<space>>.
If one is space, take the <<non-space element>>.

Perform all rotations without permanently altering any values.
If the vertical arm is longer than the horizontal one, <<print the extended vertical parts as they are>>.

<<Example:>>
```
turns = "+1 +1"

   A
   B
   A
   B
AABABAA    -- +1 turn --> BAA ABA A
   A
    
   A
   B


                               B
                               A
                                
                               A
BAA ABA A   -- +1 turn -->  AABABAA
                               B
                               A
                               B
                               A
                                   (reversed)

Output - 
BAA ABABA
AABABAA
```

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

At your favorite game, a fun challenge breaks out in the crowd! To boost harmony between rival fans, the stadium hosts a playful seat mix-up. The stands are represented as a 2D grid of seats — each cell has one of three types:

Fan A

Fan B

Space (an empty seat)

A special fan sits at a chosen center seat. From that center, imagine a plus (+) shape — the center itself, and all seats directly above, below, left, and right until the borders of the grid.

The Twist

For each given turn, the horizontal seats stay fixed while the vertical seats rotate around the center.
Positive turns: rotate the vertical line clockwise by 90° per turn.
Negative turns: rotate counterclockwise by 90° per turn.
At the end of each turns, output only the horizontal line after applying the rotation.

When vertical and horizontal seats overlap:
If both are the same fan type, that fan remains visible.
If they are rival fans, the cell becomes space.
If one is space, take the non-space element.

Perform all rotations without permanently altering any values.
If the vertical arm is longer than the horizontal one, print the extended vertical parts as they are.

Example:

turns = "+1 +1"

   A
   B
   A
   B
AABABAA    -- +1 turn --> BAA ABA A
   A
    
   A
   B


                               B
                               A
                                
                               A
BAA ABA A   -- +1 turn -->  AABABAA
                               B
                               A
                               B
                               A
                                   (reversed)

Output - 
BAA ABABA
AABABAA





   

      
Input

      
Line 1: An integer h representing the height of the grid.
Line 2: An integer w representing the width of the grid.
Line 3: An integer n representing the number of turns.
Line 4: An array of integers seperated by a space, for multiple turns.
Next h lines: A string s with length w representing 1 row of seats.

   

   

      
Output

      
One Line for Each turn: The center horizontal Line.

   

   

      
Constraints

      
The grid doesn't reset after the end of each turns.
There'll always be only one center, both row and coloumn wise.

   

   

      
Example

      

         

            
Input

            
9
7
2
+1 +1
BBBABB 
A ABAAA
ABBAABA
B BBA B
AABABAA
BBBAAAB
AAB BBB
BABAABA
B ABAB 

         

         

            
Output

            
BAA ABA A
AABABAA
